name: Spell Template
description: The core spell definition table (equivalent of Spell.dbc merged with server-side extensions): school/family/attributes, cast requirements, costs, effects and visuals for every spell id used by the server.

fields.name: Id
fields.help: Spell id (SpellEntry::Id, matches Spell.dbc).

fields.name: Category
fields.help: SpellCategory.dbc id; spells sharing a non-zero category share the Category Recovery Time cooldown.

fields.name: Cast UI
fields.help: m_castUI DBC field; not used by the core.

fields.name: Dispel
fields.help: Determines what dispel/purge effects can remove this aura and what SPELL_AURA_MOD_DEBUFF_RESISTANCE school applies.

fields.name: School
fields.help: SpellSchools enum: damage/resist school of this spell, used for resistances and school-based immunities/procs.

fields.name: Mechanic
fields.help: Used for mechanic immunity/resistance checks; also feeds GetAllEffectsMechanicMask() together with per-effect Effect Mechanic.

fields.name: Attributes
fields.help: SpellAttributes (SPELL_ATTR_*) bitmask, base spell behavior flags.

fields.name: Attributes Ex
fields.help: SpellAttributesEx (SPELL_ATTR_EX_*) bitmask.

fields.name: Attributes Ex 2
fields.help: SpellAttributesEx2 (SPELL_ATTR_EX2_*) bitmask.

fields.name: Attributes Ex 3
fields.help: SpellAttributesEx3 (SPELL_ATTR_EX3_*) bitmask.

fields.name: Attributes Ex 4
fields.help: SpellAttributesEx4 (SPELL_ATTR_EX4_*) bitmask.

fields.name: Spell Family Name
fields.help: SpellFamily enum (class family the spell belongs to for class-specific handling, e.g. Mage/Warrior/generic).

fields.name: Spell Family Flags
fields.help: 64-bit ClassFamilyMask (m_spellClassMask) used by IsFitToFamilyMask to recognize specific class abilities (e.g. all Fireball ranks) for talents/set bonuses/procs.

fields.name: Spell Priority
fields.help: m_spellPriority DBC field; marked not used by the core.

fields.name: Is Server Side
fields.help: Custom cmangos addition: marks a spell defined purely server-side (not present in the client's Spell.dbc); such spells are assigned ids above the DBC range.

fields.name: Attributes Serverside
fields.help: Custom cmangos SpellAttributesServerside bitmask, only meaningful for server-side (IsServerSide) spells.

fields.name: Stances
fields.help: ShapeshiftForm bitmask (m_shapeshiftMask): forms the caster must be in to use/learn this spell. 0 = any/no form.

fields.name: Stances Not
fields.help: ShapeshiftForm bitmask (m_shapeshiftExclude): forms that prevent using/learning this spell.

fields.name: Targets
fields.help: SpellCastTargetFlags m_targets bitmask describing valid target object types for this spell.

fields.name: Target Creature Type
fields.help: CreatureType bitmask restricting valid targets (0 = any creature type, including players).

fields.name: Requires Spell Focus
fields.help: SpellFocusObject.dbc id; caster must be within range of a gameobject using this spell focus to cast.

fields.name: Min Faction Id
fields.help: m_minFactionID; documented as 'not used' by the core.

fields.name: Min Reputation
fields.help: m_minReputation; documented as 'not used' by the core.

fields.name: Required Aura Vision
fields.help: m_requiredAuraVision (AuraVision.dbc-related bitmask); documented as 'not used' by the core.

fields.name: Caster Aura State
fields.help: AuraState the caster must have to cast this spell, 0 = none required.

fields.name: Target Aura State
fields.help: AuraState the target must have to be affected, 0 = none required.

fields.name: Casting Time Index
fields.help: SpellCastTimes.dbc id defining base cast time.

fields.name: Range Index
fields.help: SpellRange.dbc id defining min/max cast range.

fields.name: Speed
fields.help: Missile travel speed in yards/second, 0 = instant hit (m_speed).

fields.name: Recovery Time
fields.help: Spell-specific cooldown in milliseconds.

fields.name: Category Recovery Time
fields.help: Shared cooldown (ms) applied to every spell in the same Category.

fields.name: Start Recovery Category
fields.help: Global-cooldown-like category (m_startRecoveryCategory) sharing Start Recovery Time with other spells of the same category.

fields.name: Start Recovery Time
fields.help: Global-cooldown-style cooldown (ms) applied on cast start.

fields.name: Interrupt Flags
fields.help: SpellInterruptFlags bitmask: what interrupts the cast (movement, damage taken, spell cast...).

fields.name: Aura Interrupt Flags
fields.help: AuraInterruptFlags bitmask: what removes the resulting aura (movement, action, damage taken...).

fields.name: Channel Interrupt Flags
fields.help: ChannelInterruptFlags bitmask (shares the AuraInterruptFlags flag values): what interrupts channeling.

fields.name: Proc Flags
fields.help: ProcFlags bitmask: which combat events can trigger this spell's aura proc (melee hit, taken damage, cast spell...).

fields.name: Proc Chance
fields.help: Base percent chance to proc when a Proc Flags event occurs.

fields.name: Proc Charges
fields.help: Number of times the proc aura can trigger before it is removed, 0 = infinite/not a limited-charge proc.

fields.name: Base Level
fields.help: m_baseLevel; minimum caster level used for level-scaled effect calculations.

fields.name: Spell Level
fields.help: Level at which this spell/rank is normally learned; used as a fallback for Req Level style checks.

fields.name: Max Level
fields.help: Level above which level-based scaling caps, 0 = no cap.

fields.name: Max Target Level
fields.help: Maximum target level this spell can affect, 0 = no limit.

fields.name: Max Affected Targets
fields.help: Caps the number of targets hit by an area/chain effect, 0 = no cap from this field.

fields.name: Duration Index
fields.help: SpellDuration.dbc id defining base/per-level/max duration of the resulting aura.

fields.name: Power Type
fields.help: Powers enum (0 Mana, 1 Rage, 2 Focus, 3 Energy, 4 Happiness, -2 Health) consumed by Mana Cost/Mana Per Second.

fields.name: Mana Cost
fields.help: Flat Power Type cost to cast.

fields.name: Mana Cost Perlevel
fields.help: Additional Power Type cost per caster level.

fields.name: Mana Cost Percentage
fields.help: Cost expressed as a percentage of the caster's base Power Type instead of/in addition to Mana Cost.

fields.name: Mana Per Second
fields.help: Power Type drained per channel/aura tick second.

fields.name: Mana Per Second Per Level
fields.help: Additional Power Type drained per second per caster level.

fields.name: Stack Amount
fields.help: m_cumulativeAura; max stack count of the resulting aura, 0/1 = does not stack.

fields.name: Modal Next Spell
fields.help: m_modalNextSpell; documented as not used by the core.

fields.name: Totem 1
fields.help: Totem item required in hand to cast (item entry), 0 = none.

fields.name: Totem 2
fields.help: Second totem item required in hand to cast, 0 = none.

fields.name: Reagent 1
fields.help: Reagent item #1 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 2
fields.help: Reagent item #2 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 3
fields.help: Reagent item #3 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 4
fields.help: Reagent item #4 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 5
fields.help: Reagent item #5 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 6
fields.help: Reagent item #6 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 7
fields.help: Reagent item #7 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent 8
fields.help: Reagent item #8 consumed on cast, 0 = unused slot.

fields.name: Reagent Count 1
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 1 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 2
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 2 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 3
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 3 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 4
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 4 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 5
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 5 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 6
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 6 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 7
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 7 consumed.

fields.name: Reagent Count 8
fields.help: Quantity of Reagent 8 consumed.

fields.name: Equipped Item Class
fields.help: ItemClass the caster must have equipped to cast (e.g. weapon), -1 = no requirement.

fields.name: Equipped Item Sub Class Mask
fields.help: Bitmask of item subclasses (interpreted against Equipped Item Class) that satisfy the equip requirement, e.g. weapon subclass mask when Equipped Item Class = Weapon.

fields.name: Equipped Item Inventory Type Mask
fields.help: Bitmask of InventoryType values (1 << InventoryType) that satisfy the equip requirement.

fields.name: Effect Die Sides 1
fields.help: Random roll size for effect 1 (Base Points + random(1..DieSides)).

fields.name: Effect Die Sides 2
fields.help: Random roll size for effect 2 (Base Points + random(1..DieSides)).

fields.name: Effect Die Sides 3
fields.help: Random roll size for effect 3 (Base Points + random(1..DieSides)).

fields.name: Effect Base Dice 1
fields.help: Fixed offset added to Effect Base Points 1 (CalculateSimpleValue = BasePoints + BaseDice, usually 1); also the lower bound of the die roll.

fields.name: Effect Base Dice 2
fields.help: Fixed offset added to Effect Base Points 2 (CalculateSimpleValue = BasePoints + BaseDice, usually 1); also the lower bound of the die roll.

fields.name: Effect Base Dice 3
fields.help: Fixed offset added to Effect Base Points 3 (CalculateSimpleValue = BasePoints + BaseDice, usually 1); also the lower bound of the die roll.

fields.name: Effect Dice Per Level 1
fields.help: Additional die roll size for effect 1 per caster level (legacy DBC field).

fields.name: Effect Dice Per Level 2
fields.help: Additional die roll size for effect 2 per caster level (legacy DBC field).

fields.name: Effect Dice Per Level 3
fields.help: Additional die roll size for effect 3 per caster level (legacy DBC field).

fields.name: Effect Base Points 1
fields.help: Base value for effect 1 (actual applied value is Base Points + 1, then randomized by Die Sides and scaled by level/combo points/AP/spellpower coefficients).

fields.name: Effect Base Points 2
fields.help: Base value for effect 2 (actual applied value is Base Points + 1, then randomized by Die Sides and scaled by level/combo points/AP/spellpower coefficients).

fields.name: Effect Base Points 3
fields.help: Base value for effect 3 (actual applied value is Base Points + 1, then randomized by Die Sides and scaled by level/combo points/AP/spellpower coefficients).

fields.name: Effect Real Points Per Level 1
fields.help: Additional effect 1 value per caster level above Base Level.

fields.name: Effect Real Points Per Level 2
fields.help: Additional effect 2 value per caster level above Base Level.

fields.name: Effect Real Points Per Level 3
fields.help: Additional effect 3 value per caster level above Base Level.

fields.name: Effect Mechanic 1
fields.help: Mechanic applied specifically by effect 1.

fields.name: Effect Mechanic 2
fields.help: Mechanic applied specifically by effect 2.

fields.name: Effect Mechanic 3
fields.help: Mechanic applied specifically by effect 3.

fields.name: Effect Implicit Target A 1
fields.help: Targets enum: primary implicit target selector for effect 1 (e.g. self, target unit, area around caster...).

fields.name: Effect Implicit Target A 2
fields.help: Targets enum: primary implicit target selector for effect 2 (e.g. self, target unit, area around caster...).

fields.name: Effect Implicit Target A 3
fields.help: Targets enum: primary implicit target selector for effect 3 (e.g. self, target unit, area around caster...).

fields.name: Effect Implicit Target B 1
fields.help: Targets enum: secondary implicit target selector for effect 1, used together with Implicit Target A.

fields.name: Effect Implicit Target B 2
fields.help: Targets enum: secondary implicit target selector for effect 2, used together with Implicit Target A.

fields.name: Effect Implicit Target B 3
fields.help: Targets enum: secondary implicit target selector for effect 3, used together with Implicit Target A.

fields.name: Effect Radius Index 1
fields.help: SpellRadius.dbc id defining the area radius of effect 1 for area target selectors.

fields.name: Effect Radius Index 2
fields.help: SpellRadius.dbc id defining the area radius of effect 2 for area target selectors.

fields.name: Effect Radius Index 3
fields.help: SpellRadius.dbc id defining the area radius of effect 3 for area target selectors.

fields.name: Effect Apply Aura Name 1
fields.help: Aura applied by effect 1 when Effect 1 = APPLY_AURA.

fields.name: Effect Apply Aura Name 2
fields.help: Aura applied by effect 2 when Effect 2 = APPLY_AURA.

fields.name: Effect Apply Aura Name 3
fields.help: Aura applied by effect 3 when Effect 3 = APPLY_AURA.

fields.name: Effect Amplitude 1
fields.help: Periodic tick interval in ms for effect 1's aura, 0 = not periodic.

fields.name: Effect Amplitude 2
fields.help: Periodic tick interval in ms for effect 2's aura, 0 = not periodic.

fields.name: Effect Amplitude 3
fields.help: Periodic tick interval in ms for effect 3's aura, 0 = not periodic.

fields.name: Effect Multiple Value 1
fields.help: Extra float multiplier/value for effect 1 (meaning depends on Effect 1/Apply Aura Name).

fields.name: Effect Multiple Value 2
fields.help: Extra float multiplier/value for effect 2 (meaning depends on Effect 2/Apply Aura Name).

fields.name: Effect Multiple Value 3
fields.help: Extra float multiplier/value for effect 3 (meaning depends on Effect 3/Apply Aura Name).

fields.name: Effect Chain Target 1
fields.help: Number of extra chain/jump targets for effect 1 (e.g. Chain Lightning), 0/1 = no chaining.

fields.name: Effect Chain Target 2
fields.help: Number of extra chain/jump targets for effect 2 (e.g. Chain Lightning), 0/1 = no chaining.

fields.name: Effect Chain Target 3
fields.help: Number of extra chain/jump targets for effect 3 (e.g. Chain Lightning), 0/1 = no chaining.

fields.name: Effect Item Type 1
fields.help: Item created/enchanted by effect 1 (e.g. CREATE_ITEM effect), 0 = none.

fields.name: Effect Item Type 2
fields.help: Item created/enchanted by effect 2 (e.g. CREATE_ITEM effect), 0 = none.

fields.name: Effect Item Type 3
fields.help: Item created/enchanted by effect 3 (e.g. CREATE_ITEM effect), 0 = none.

fields.name: Effect Misc Value 1
fields.help: Generic effect 1 parameter whose meaning depends on Effect 1 / Effect Apply Aura Name 1 (e.g. summoned creature id, dispel school, misc enum value...).

fields.name: Effect Misc Value 2
fields.help: Generic effect 2 parameter whose meaning depends on Effect 2 / Effect Apply Aura Name 2 (e.g. summoned creature id, dispel school, misc enum value...).

fields.name: Effect Misc Value 3
fields.help: Generic effect 3 parameter whose meaning depends on Effect 3 / Effect Apply Aura Name 3 (e.g. summoned creature id, dispel school, misc enum value...).

fields.name: Effect Trigger Spell 1
fields.help: Spell triggered/cast by effect 1 (e.g. TRIGGER_SPELL effect, or the spell applied by a proc aura), 0 = none.

fields.name: Effect Trigger Spell 2
fields.help: Spell triggered/cast by effect 2 (e.g. TRIGGER_SPELL effect, or the spell applied by a proc aura), 0 = none.

fields.name: Effect Trigger Spell 3
fields.help: Spell triggered/cast by effect 3 (e.g. TRIGGER_SPELL effect, or the spell applied by a proc aura), 0 = none.

fields.name: Effect Points Per Combo Point 1
fields.help: Additional effect 1 value per combo point spent (rogue/druid finishers).

fields.name: Effect Points Per Combo Point 2
fields.help: Additional effect 2 value per combo point spent (rogue/druid finishers).

fields.name: Effect Points Per Combo Point 3
fields.help: Additional effect 3 value per combo point spent (rogue/druid finishers).

fields.name: Dmg Multiplier 1
fields.help: Per-chain-jump damage multiplier applied to effect 1 on each successive chain target (m_effectChainAmplitude).

fields.name: Dmg Multiplier 2
fields.help: Per-chain-jump damage multiplier applied to effect 2 on each successive chain target (m_effectChainAmplitude).

fields.name: Dmg Multiplier 3
fields.help: Per-chain-jump damage multiplier applied to effect 3 on each successive chain target (m_effectChainAmplitude).

fields.name: Effect Bonus Coefficient 1
fields.help: Spell power scaling coefficient applied to effect 1's value.

fields.name: Effect Bonus Coefficient 2
fields.help: Spell power scaling coefficient applied to effect 2's value.

fields.name: Effect Bonus Coefficient 3
fields.help: Spell power scaling coefficient applied to effect 3's value.

fields.name: Effect Bonus Coefficient From AP 1
fields.help: Attack power scaling coefficient applied to effect 1's value.

fields.name: Effect Bonus Coefficient From AP 2
fields.help: Attack power scaling coefficient applied to effect 2's value.

fields.name: Effect Bonus Coefficient From AP 3
fields.help: Attack power scaling coefficient applied to effect 3's value.

fields.name: Spell Visual
fields.help: SpellVisual.dbc id (primary).

fields.name: Spell Icon ID
fields.help: SpellIcon.dbc id shown in the client spellbook/aura icon.

fields.name: Active Icon ID
fields.help: SpellIcon.dbc id shown while the spell is active/toggled (e.g. stances).

fields.name: Dmg Class
fields.help: m_defenseType; determines whether the effect can be resisted/parried/dodged/blocked like a melee attack.

fields.name: Prevention Type
fields.help: What the resulting aura prevents the target from doing.

fields.name: Stance Bar Order
fields.help: m_stanceBarOrder; documented as not used by the core.

fields.name: Spell Name 1
fields.help: Locale enUS name.

fields.name: Spell Name 2
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 2 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Spell Name 3
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 3 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Spell Name 4
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 4 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Spell Name 5
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 5 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Spell Name 6
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 6 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Spell Name 7
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 7 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Spell Name 8
fields.help: Localized name, locale slot 8 (see mangos_string/Locales.h locale order).

fields.name: Rank 1
fields.help: Locale enUS rank/subtext text (e.g. 'Rank 3').

fields.name: Rank 2
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 2.

fields.name: Rank 3
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 3.

fields.name: Rank 4
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 4.

fields.name: Rank 5
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 5.

fields.name: Rank 6
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 6.

fields.name: Rank 7
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 7.

fields.name: Rank 8
fields.help: Localized rank/subtext text, locale slot 8.

fields.name: Chain (ranks)
fields.help: Rank chain rows of this spell.

fields.name: Learn Spell
fields.help: Spells learned when casting this spell.

fields.name: Proc Event
fields.help: Proc event definition.

fields.name: Threat
fields.help: Threat override of this spell.

fields.name: Target Position
fields.help: Teleport / target destination of this spell.

fields.name: Script Target
fields.help: Script targets of this spell.

fields.name: Area Requirements
fields.help: Area-bound aura application rules.

fields.name: Pet Auras
fields.help: Pet auras applied by this spell.

fields.name: Elixir
fields.help: Elixir classification of this spell.

fields.name: Facing
fields.help: Facing requirements of this spell.

fields.name: Affect
fields.help: Spell family mask overrides (spell_affect).

fields.name: Cone
fields.help: Cone angle of this spell.

fields.name: Skill Discovery
fields.help: Discovery rules of this spell.

fields.name: Skill Extra Item
fields.help: Extra item creation rules of this spell.
